$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: Founder-approved 2026-10-09 (v2 Sprint 1 X1, the post-GA merge of integration/v1.3 into main), on the condition that the stable v1.0 credential fingerprints do not move. They do not: a credential run fingerprints --repo-root = a checkout of the pinned rcTag (v1.0.0-rc.6), and only --workflow-file (.github/workflows/test-e2e-deploy.yml) comes from main. That workflow file is byte-identical to main in this merge (sha256 d4450d75c7ec208d984931df456eb3e80e97636eb7d947b6f986095734fc7b1f both sides), and the fingerprints of the four stable cells (node, bun, node-webpack, bun-webpack) computed over a v1.0.0-rc.6 checkout are byte-identical with the workflow taken from main and from this merge. The frozen files this merge changes are scripts/e2e-deploy-vinext.sh and .github/workflows/compat-vinext.yml (the Beta vinext lane, not one of the four stable cells; neither is read from main by a stable-cell credential run) plus this pin file. scripts/e2e-deploy.sh keeps main's bytes and test-e2e-deploy.yml is unchanged. rcTag unchanged (v1.0.0-rc.6).

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Founder-approved 2026-10-09 (v2 Sprint 1 X1, the post-GA merge of integration/v1.3 into main). Merging the 1.3 line inherently changes published bytes in the three-package publishable group plus the kn-next alias: the version fields move from 1.0.0 to 1.3.0 and the 1.3 line's package source, templates, bundled vinext patches and READMEs come with it. This is the intended content of the merge, not an accident, and no v1.0 credential window is restarted by it: a stable-cell credential run fingerprints a checkout of the pinned rcTag (v1.0.0-rc.6), not main, and the four stable-cell fingerprints are byte-identical with the workflow from main and from this merge (see the PR body). rcTag unchanged (v1.0.0-rc.6). This replaces the C1 vinext-3689 marker that the 1.3 line carried, which no longer describes the change.
